items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: So I played with her show. A guy from Chicago, Willie Show (Shearns) and his Bandwagon.

ctx.x: Can't remember that, well go ahead.

But I do remember that she wasn't too hot on her jazz and everything like that. But the ballads were lovely and I fell for her right then and there. (LAUGHTER). So I played with her show. A guy from Chicago, Willie Show (Shearns) and his Bandwagon. And he knew me and of course all the musicians knew me and everything like that.
And she played a little accordion too, believe it or not. Because we used to go right behind the front lines. You could hear small arms firing you know
